result.topic_en: Geometric and arithmetic computations with the Gaussian prime 7+12i (norm 193) and 1+2i, including a lattice diagram of a tilted square, reduction of Gaussian integers modulo 7+12i, and a congruence for the 48th power of (1+2i)/(7+12i) modulo 193 related to biquadratic residues.

methods.what: Division by the Gaussian prime 7+12i via multiplication by its conjugate-related factor, giving coordinates over the norm 193
Norm of 7+12i written as 4·48+1, so the biquadratic character uses exponent 48 = (193-1)/4
Biquadratic residue symbol computed via Euler-type criterion: raising (1+2i)/(7+12i) to the power (N-1)/4 modulo 193
Euclidean-type reduction sequence of Gaussian integers starting from 7+12i
Linear system solved for lattice coordinates
